title: termal_evaluate_acceptance with agent=Auto from a Kimi session returns HTTP 400 requiring Claude or Codex instead of resolving an allowed evaluator
outcome: termal_evaluate_acceptance with agent=Auto from a Kimi session returns HTTP 400 requiring Claude or Codex instead of resolving an allowed evaluator
acceptance: Automatic acceptance-evaluator selection from Kimi, Cursor, Gemini or OpenCode never selects an unsupported evaluator. It chooses a ready, nonblocking Codex or Claude in the documented deterministic order, with Codex as the supported fallback when neither is ready; existing Claude/Codex parent selection behavior remains unchanged.

Explicit request, eligible reuse and supported project defaults retain their precedence; explicit unsupported evaluator agents remain refused, and vendor-specific model overrides are not carried to an automatically selected different vendor. Tool/help text describes automatic selection accurately. Deterministic tests cover unsupported-parent ready/missing/blocked/empty-readiness cases and the request path, while preserving existing evaluator admission and source-root preflight behavior.
